title: Bundled is not necessarily fused
purpose: Distinguish graph submission, packed storage and physical kernel fusion.
contract: Separate, bundled and concatenated describe different implementation choices.
Concatenated output widths are Pq, Pkv, Pkv; equal-thirds splitting fails for GQA.
